Agarwal, Chomsisengphet, Mahoney, Stroebel (QJE 2018) Table IV, QJE pp. 154-155 = PDF pp. 26-27 of
acms2018_passthrough_stern.pdf. The pages are printed landscape, so pdfplumber emits each text run
reversed; every line below is the extracted line reversed back. Within each block of four values the
order is >740, 701-740, 661-700, <=660 (the '(cid:2)660' token is the paper's '<=660'), and the value
blocks follow the order of the three column titles listed just above them.
